hypothesis: On a falling 24h window, buying 60-120bp dips below the 60-bar mean in 25%-of-equity sleeves and exiting at +150bp TP / -35bp SL / mean recovery clears the dev gate (net PnL > $0) with maxDD far below the 25% guardrail. Dev window fell -2.80%; the strategy's edge is mean reversion after dips, not trend following.

local_grade_output.method: Docker is NOT available on this VM, and `grade-local --driver process` runs node22 entries only (python3.13 runs only inside Docker). Graded with a faithful local replay simulator (/tmp/sim.py) replicating sim/bars/engine.ts exactly: BigInt-truncating fill math, buy price = open x 1.0002 x y(y+s)/D^2, sell price = open x 0.9998 x y^2/(D^2+v*y), decision checks in engine order, fills at next bar's open, flatten at last close vs c_depth, equity points per batch, maxDD over equity points, determinism = two runs byte-identical replies. Validated against the kit buy-and-hold baseline: net PnL -$31.63, maxDD 3.25%, 1 trade (matches hand computation: -2.8% drift + ~$2.6 entry/exit costs + $0.79 fees). This is NOT the official grade-local output; the parent should run the official check.

accepted_with_justification: D3 hardcoded WINDOW_BARS=1440: accepted. The window length is fixed by the competition (RULES.txt: 1,440 bars for dev and race windows; kit dataset exactly 1,440), not a runtime variable; the harness also rejects last-batch orders itself (after_end), so the gate is belt-and-braces only. Renamed N_BARS -> WINDOW_BARS with a comment stating this.

R1-R11 strategy risks (thin edge ~+$0.50/trade net, sleeve 2 unfiltered, no time-based exit, flat-window 0-trade risk, mean-exit decay, decorative TP, no depth awareness, re-entry delay, 1-bar fill latency, hardcoded hello assumptions, permissive trend filter): accepted as properties of the chosen strategy; fixing any would be a strategy change, out of scope for this build.
fixes_applied: D1 std-gate scaling (x100 error): gate was vacuous (threshold std_bps//100 = 0). Fixed formula to dip_bps*100 < STD_MULT_BPS*std_bps (100 = 1.0x std). Unit-tested: 60bp dip blocked when 60-bar std ~120bps; 150bp dip passes and buys. Dev numbers unchanged (std 15-30bps on dev, dip >= 60 always passes a 1.0x gate).

D2 missing-bar blind spot: bot now returns [] (after applying fills) on any batch with no CBBTC bar, so no stale close is appended and no orders are decided on gap batches. Unit-tested: 3 gap batches in 70 bars -> 67 closes appended, no orders on gap bars.

D4 SL cooldown on decision, not fill: cooldown now starts only when a stop-loss sell actually fills (measured from the decision bar, preserving the tuned 5-bar window); a rejected stop sets no cooldown and frees the lot. Unit-tested both paths.

D5 MAX_SLIP_BPS 100 -> 40: worst-case realized stop cut from ~135bps to ~75bps. Verified zero dev impact for MAX_SLIP in {35,40,50,70,100} (all +$4.98 pre-cutoff, 0 rejections); 40 covers the p99 1-min move (25bps) with margin.
D6 late-window entry cutoff: no new sleeve in the last 15 bars (dev winning exits took 10-16 bars). Removes the dev buy at seq 1431, which lost -$1.57 (stopped out at 1434). Dev PnL +$4.98 -> +$6.55.
D7 docstring: fixed cooldown 15->5 bars, warmup 30 vs effective 61 closes, sizing description, BUILD-REPORT.json reference now true (this file ships in the repo).
